title: Criatura sob o gelo
summary: Um veículo de pesquisa minúsculo sobre gelo azul translúcido e uma sombra colossal abaixo.
prompt:
CRIA / VIDEO DIRECTION — CRIATURA SOB O GELO

DELIVERY
15-second finished video, 16:9, 24fps delivery unless the sequence explicitly calls for time-lapse or slow motion. Timings describe the finished edit. If the selected generator supports shorter clips, generate each timed shot separately with the same references, then assemble the edit; do not cram the full narrative into one unsupported generation.
FRAME COMPOSITION: Native horizontal 16:9 video. Compose the action for this landscape frame; no pillarboxing or letterboxing.

REFERENCES
No external reference is required. Fix the subject design, costume or object design in the first frame and preserve it throughout.

DIRECTION & CINEMATOGRAPHY
Virtual 27mm overhead and 50mm surface insert; three readable scale beats, consistent ice load and concealed creature detail until the end.
ARRI Alexa 35 visual language for normal-speed live action: organic highlight roll-off, natural skin and material texture, restrained sharpening, believable motion blur and controlled contrast. A named camera is an aesthetic reference, not a promise of actual capture. Use a dedicated high-speed-imaging look for slow-motion inserts rather than attributing unsupported frame rates to Alexa.

SEQUENCE
[0–4s] A small tracked research vehicle crosses translucent lake ice; a muffled boom and thin cracks appear behind it.
[4–10s] A direct overhead cut reveals an enormous dark silhouette matching the vehicle's direction beneath the ice; displacement moves trapped bubbles.
[10–15s] The silhouette turns upward and becomes anatomically clearer only in the last two seconds; ice bulges and the video cuts to black before impact.

VFX & CONTINUITY
Houdini-level finish where effects are needed: stable camera tracking, correct occlusion, grounded contact, coherent light direction, reflections and shadows. Couple rigid bodies, cloth, particles, smoke and fluids only when the scene calls for them. Respect mass, momentum and material response around the explicitly fictional event. Do not apply generic glow to every object.

AUDIO
Arctic wind, vehicle engine, deep muffled underwater movement and sharp ice cracks; no music.
If the chosen tool cannot generate usable audio, produce these layers in post. Any specified spoken lines remain natural Brazilian Portuguese and must fit their shot duration.

FINISH & RESTRICTIONS
Keep subject count, spatial geography, light direction and object ownership consistent. No identity drift, extra fingers, duplicate objects, intersecting surfaces, unmotivated morphs, watermark or burned-in subtitles. Exact lettering, interfaces and planned overlays are composited in post rather than hallucinated by the video model. Preserve any intentional text-based story device in the edit.
